title: Answer: the self is an embodied self-model

statements.text: The self is a set of embodied self-models, body maps that are also control hierarchies, which scaffold attention, imagination and action. Minimal agentic selfhood is needed for the causal coherence of any experienced world.

sources.quote: ESMs are both body maps and cybernetic control hierarchies
embodied self-models (ESMs), understood as body maps with agentic properties, functioning as predictive-memory systems and cybernetic controllers
all of which likely require minimal agentic selfhood
